ai-2/10.title: Read a record by its labels
ai-2/10.studentExplanation: Think of a dictionary as a small form with labelled boxes. The label capacity tells us which number means the total space; used tells us which number means occupied space. To find spare space, look up both values and subtract used from capacity. After used changes from 4 to 6, read the form again: 12 minus 6 is 6. Do not reuse the old answer 8. The labels stay the same while a value can change.

ai-2/11.title: Keep a running total
ai-2/11.studentExplanation: Use a paper table with one row per cupboard and columns for capacity, used, spare and running total. Start the running total at 0 once. The accumulator is like a collection box: empty it before collecting, rather than emptying it before every item.
